Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 33: the slip of [[Diversionary Tactics (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“USED: Target one piloted starship at a system. That starship is hyperspeed -1 for remainder of turn. LOST: If you have two unique (•) piloted Rebel (or [Republic]) starfighters in battle at a system, draw destiny. If destiny < 4, exclude one starship from that battle.”), word for word the text of [[Diversionary Tactics (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
